en.headline: Woman, 89, dies after morning swim at Tsuen Wan Approach Beach
en.dek: Firefighters pulled the unconscious swimmer from the water off Ting Kau shortly after 5am; she was certified dead at Yan Chai Hospital.
body: An 89-year-old woman died after a suspected drowning during an early-morning swim at Approach Beach in Tsuen Wan on Sunday, police and rescue services said.

A report was received at about 5.18am that a woman who had gone into the water at the Ting Kau beach had not come ashore. Other swimmers told officers they later saw her floating farther out. Firefighters recovered her unconscious from the sea and ambulance crews took her to Yan Chai Hospital, where she was certified dead.

Police are investigating. Other bathers at the unofficial early-swim spot said currents farther offshore were strong. Approach Beach is not a gazetted public beach with a lifeguard service at that hour.

zh.headline: 荃灣近水灣泳灘89歲婦人早泳遇溺不治
zh.dek: 消防今早約5時18分後在汀九近水灣救起昏迷泳客，送往仁濟醫院後證實死亡，警方列遇溺調查。
body: 一名89歲婦人周日清晨在荃灣汀九近水灣泳灘游早水期間懷疑遇溺，送院後不治。
警方約清晨5時18分接報，指有婦人下水後未見上岸。在場泳客其後發現她在較遠海面載浮載沉。消防到場將昏迷事主救起，由救護車送往仁濟醫院搶救，其後證實死亡。
案件由警方列作遇溺調查。有在場泳客表示，離岸較遠位置水流頗急。近水灣並非設有當值救生員的憲報泳灘，清晨時段亦無官方救生服務。
